title: Symbol-U Concern -> Sanskrit Concept Mapping
description: Frozen, versioned, table-driven mapping from each canonical concern id to one canonical Sanskrit concept word. Purely deterministic: no free generation. When multiple candidate concepts exist, a deterministic selection rule picks the canonical one.

concern_ontology_sha256.description: the exact concern ontology this table is bound to

selection_rule.description: deterministic rule to pick the canonical concept when >1 candidate: 1) prefer entry with rank=1; 2) tie-break by highest Tier-1 varna coverage; 3) tie-break by ascending IAST codepoint. Frozen.

gloss.description: ordinary meaning of the Sanskrit word (NOT a varna mapping)

candidates.description: all attested candidate concepts considered, with the deterministic rank used by selection_rule
